prompt: An ultra-realistic photograph of a warm and professional consultation at a modern pharmacy counter, shot on a DSLR camera with an 85mm lens at f/1.4, shallow depth of field. A friendly female pharmacist in her 30s wearing a crisp white lab coat is holding a digital tablet, gesturing gently as she speaks. A customer stands opposite her, listening attentively, shown from an over-the-shoulder perspective. The background is a bright, modern pharmacy interior with neatly arranged shelves of medicine boxes, beautifully out of focus with soft bokeh. The composition is a 16:9 landscape, intentionally designed with a softly blurred, clean, and open negative space in the upper right third of the frame for future text overlay. Warm, soft, professional indoor lighting illuminates the scene, highlighting realistic skin textures and creating a welcoming, trustworthy atmosphere. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, and no signage on any packaging or in the background, pure photorealism.
